chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning's First Life-and-Death Cage Battle: Unleashing the Crimsonbright Diagram
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning enters Dragon Fort for his first Cage Battle against a Howling Moon Wolf with a Fiendgod bloodline. Will his Houtian Ki Refining be enough, or will he be forced to unleash the true power of the Crimsonbright Diagram?
